author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want to organize your inbox without spending hours sorting email? I’ll walk through five practical Outlook tips to reduce clutter, keep track of follow-ups, and find the messages that actually need your attention. Then I’ll show you how Superhuman Mail uses AI to make organization even easier and help you achieve Inbox Zero! 🎁 Try Superhuman Mail: Superhuman Mail is celebrating Inbox Zero Day on October 6! New users who sign up through October 16 can get two months free at https://superhuman.com/elizabeth

An overflowing inbox can make every message feel equally urgent. Newsletters sit beside client requests; reminders get buried, and emails you’ve already handled stay in your way. You don’t need a complicated system to fix that. A few useful Outlook features and consistent habits can make a big difference.

In this video, you’ll learn how to:
    - Create Outlook Rules that automatically move or prioritize incoming emails
    - Use Categories to see what needs action, what’s importan
title: How to Organize Your Email Inbox (And Keep it That Way!)
